newsitem.title: BELGIUM: PetroFina fills up on Brussels bourse.
newsitem.headline: PetroFina fills up on Brussels bourse.

text.p: Shares in Belgian energy group PetroFina, a heavyweight in the Bel-20 index, gained a strong 475 francs at 13,700 on Wednesday after the stock broke above chart resistance in the 12,975 - 13,650 franc area.

Apart from the positive technicals, dealers said, the market was also looking forward to an update from the company on trading conditions in a report due to be filed as part of its September listing in New York.
The company is awaiting SEC approval for the share listing, which also involves a friendly cash offer to buy out minority shareholders of its U.S. unit Fina Inc.
Reportedly, PetroFina is also seeking a listing in Amsterdam for its Dutch coatings subsidiary Sigma.
PetroFina has said Sigma did not fit in with the group and that it would like Sigma to be strong enough "so that it could realise its potential as an independent company."
Bank BBL brokerage Vemeulen Raemdonck said in its latest analysis it rated PetroFina a 'buy'.

Recently agreed tighter environmental measures for refined oil products should not be to PetroFina's detriment. "The adoption of increasingly strict fuel production standards widens the prospects for the most modern refineries, i.e. Petrofina ones," it said.

It noted PetroFina and Conoco were ahead of the competition in conversion and desulphurisation in Europe "which should bring them in extremely good positions to face these levels of product specification without major investment."
